steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: The model is a mirror. It reflects whatever data you feed it. Feed it garbage, it reflects garbage with perfect fluency.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You have a tokenizer. Now you need data.

Not a dataset. Not a CSV file. Terabytes of text -- cleaned, deduplicated, filtered for quality, tokenized into fixed-length sequences, and served in randomized batches fast enough that your 8-GPU cluster never waits for the next batch.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Shuffle, pack, mask for pretraining. Web-scale dedup.
